reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: The phone shot fills with two floors of balconies, doors and AC units over the SURE POS & TRANSFER board: named as shops under flats in one look; the roof and the full height are out of frame.
reasons.silhouette: The front says a three-storey plaza with shops, balconies and a gate; the left side shows the outside stair to a first-floor door; the right side and the back are near-blank walls.
reasons.proportion: Storeys, windows, rails and doors agree with the person and each other, and the stair reaches its landing door; the back has a single first-floor window and none above.
reasons.palette: Palette only, but the peach walls and peach roof slab sit close in tone to the sand in the three-quarter view, and the upper floors carry no worn shade.
reasons.wear: Roof tanks now seen from above, AC units between windows, generator by the gate, drain with slabs, louvres and barred ground windows; the upper walls and parapet are clean.
reasons.variety: Same kit, boards and drain as the shop row, plainly its own three-storey type.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 1,436 of 1,500, drawCalls 1 of 1, materials 1 of 1, bytes 14,384 of 40,000; inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.
